_comment: The Wanderer's lost friend, dead at the back of the kobold cave (koboldCave.json, the east chamber): the talk_to target of `the-lost-friend`, the zone-2 'lost friend' beat (content-zone-2-woodland.md §3.3). dead-carter.json's shape: unattackable (townsfolk, collisionLayer 97), speed 0, xpFactor 0, one lore node with no options; opening the panel is the talk. Its lines match the Wanderer's brief (grey cloak, walking staff) and read true without the quest, so nothing is gated. EntityType Remains. All values [PLACEHOLDER]; text plain.
name: FallenTraveller

lines.text: A dead traveller in a grey cloak, deep in the kobold den.
His pack has been emptied. A broken walking staff lies beside him.
